newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ministers await parliament on food origin schedule.
newsitem.headline: Ministers await parliament on food origin schedule.

text.p: Farm ministers postponed a decision to change the transition period for foodstuffs on an official list of geographical origins until the European Parliament gives its opinion, EU officials said on Tuesday.

The point was raised by Denmark, which is concerned about the future of its producers of feta cheese, which was designated a Greek product in a first list of regional foodstuffs adopted by the Commission in June.
The original decision setting up a system of geographic names (Regulation 2081/92) set a five year transition period to allow firms marketing food under those names time to adjust.
The European Commission has now proposed that the five year period should begin after publication of the regulation on July 25, 1997.
